build_hungarian_assigner: build a HungarianAssigner instance with custom classification, regression, and IoU cost configurations
assign_bbox_predictions: assign predicted bounding boxes to ground truth using Hungarian matching based on weighted costs
configure_cls_cost: configure the classification cost component with a custom weight for the HungarianAssigner
configure_reg_cost: configure the regression L1 cost component with a custom weight for the HungarianAssigner
configure_iou_cost: configure the IoU cost component with giou mode and custom weight for the HungarianAssigner
